yesterday we made it to the 3rd and final country- Indonesia. jenna and i got up early to take the ferry 45 min to Bintan. glad peter recommended bintan instead of Bantam, apparently Bantam is full of hookers and i've seen enough of them this trip. once we got to Bintan we paid (we were suckered) $30 round trip to take a cab from the ferry to a resort- Nirwana Gardens. the resort was pretty cool. white soft beaches, clear blue warm water, a fabulous pool! it was a great end to a fabulous vacation. the only thing that was not fab was the food. jenna had the most disgusting lunch! she ordered the fish. when we got our food she took a bite and had to most horrid look on her face. i said i'll take that as a nasty food face. she's like it smells. only until i got a whiff did i understand- it smelled like sewer. she covered it up asap and then we moved on. for dinner we ordered what we thought were sure things: pasta, salad, potato cuts, and pizza strips. everything but the pizza came and it was good. the waiter dropped off the pizza and it smelled like fish again. i though it was calamari legs so i took a bite- jenna brushed the stuff off. only after my bite did i realize there were little freakin sardines on the pizza with their little eyes looking at me. it was horrible- i thought i was going to puke. the waiter came back and said oh, i guess you ordered too much food? i said no, we didn't know there were sardines on the pizza. he asked, you've never had pizza strips before? like sardines on them are the most common things in the world. i was like apparently i've never had indonesian pizza strips!! nasty!!
